WITH search_url_manifest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT value COLLATE pg_catalog."C" AS value FROM (SELECT v."urlValue" AS value FROM "CollectibleItem" i JOIN "Collection" c ON c.id=i."collectionId" AND c."ownerId"=i."ownerId" JOIN "CustomFieldValue" v ON v."itemId"=i.id AND v."collectionId"=i."collectionId" AND v."fieldType"='URL' WHERE (i."ownerId"=$1 AND c."ownerId"=$2 AND i."deletedAt" IS NULL AND c."deletedAt" IS NULL AND i."archivedAt" IS NULL AND i."disposedAt" IS NULL) AND (i."collectionId"=$3::uuid AND v."fieldDefinitionId"=$4::uuid)) selected_urls LIMIT 4097
    ), sizes AS (
      SELECT count(*) AS count, COALESCE(sum(octet_length(value)),0)::bigint AS bytes FROM search_url_manifest
    )
    SELECT count,bytes,CASE WHEN count<=4096 AND bytes<=8388608
      THEN (SELECT array_agg(value) FROM search_url_manifest) ELSE NULL END AS values FROM sizes
